name: chpli2
description: CHPLI - A Personal System for Life and Growth

scripts.dev: pnpm -C services/api db:migrate && concurrently -n api,host,travel,calendar,notes,bookmarks,growth,lifefolder -c blue,green,yellow,magenta,cyan,red,gray,white "pnpm -C services/api start:dev" "pnpm -C apps/host dev" "pnpm -C apps/travel dev" "pnpm -C apps/calendar dev" "pnpm -C apps/notes dev" "pnpm -C apps/bookmarks dev" "pnpm -C apps/growth dev" "pnpm -C apps/lifefolder dev"
scripts.verify: pnpm check:e2e-selectors && pnpm check:i18n && pnpm typecheck && pnpm -r --workspace-concurrency=1 --filter '!./e2e' test
